## What You Need Before Checking Your CBSE Class 10 Result?

****Ensure you have the following safely with you before checking your class 10 CBSE results:****

### 1. Essential Credentials from Your Admit Card

Your school number, roll number, and date of birth are crucial to get the access to your CBSE class 10 results**.**

All of these are **already given on the CBSE Class 10 admit card**. You may fail to get your result online unless you have the right credentials.

### 2. Technical Preparations

**Make sure that you possess a stable internet connection in case you check your Class 10 CBSE results online**. In case one **website isn’t working you can search your results on other links like** [**cbseresults.nic.in**](http://cbseresults.nic.in)**,** [**results.cbse.nic.in**](http://results.cbse.nic.in)**,** [**cbse.nic.in**](http://cbse.nic.in)**,** [**digilocker.gov.in**](http://digilocker.gov.in)**, and** [**results.gov.in**](http://results.gov.in)**.**

You can either visit a cyber cafe if you are not [confident](https://www.21kschool.com/us/blog/confidence-vs-knowledge/#What_is_Confidence) of your internet connection, or can check your results by yourself through a smartphone or laptop.

Saving the result as PDF can be helpful for future use.

If you cannot login to the official websites on the results day, don’t panic because it might be due to multiple logins at the same time.

## How to Check Result of Class 10 CBSE?

If you wonder how to check the result of class 10 CBSE, you can follow the blueprint explained individually for each way to access it.

### 1. Method 1: Check Result of Class 10 CBSE Online (Official Website)

This is the **most commonly used method. Enter the portal of CBSE results cbseresults.nic.in.** On the page displayed, click on the Class 10 Results section**.**

Now, **enter your roll number, school number, admit card ID and date of birth**. Your results will be displayed on the screen.

**Click on the download** **button** **to get the result and print it out** for later reference.

### 2. Method 2: Check Result of Class 10 CBSE via DigiLocker

Another way to see class 10 CBSE results is through DigiLocker, which is also used [to get the CBSE 10th marksheet online.](https://www.21kschool.com/us/blog/how-to-get-cbse-10th-marksheet-online/) You can easily login here with your mobile number and Aadhaar details, and have a digital version of your results.

After this, you will see a “Issued Documents” section where all your essential documents might be visible.

You can use this document for admission in higher institutions as they are authentic and digitally signed by the officials.

### 3. Method 3: Check Result of Class 10 CBSE Through UMANG App

**UMANG app, which is available on Play Store for androids and Apple Store for Iphones, can also be utilized for accessing CBSE class results**.

All you have to do is to register on this app through your contact number. UMANG app provides multiple government services including CBSE services.

So, search for CBSE services and fill in all the required details to find your CBSE class 10 results there.

### 4. Method 4: Check Result of Class 10 CBSE via SMS

If you are someone who lives in remote areas and don’t have good access to the internet, you can have your results through a text or a call.

The contact number for getting your results is announced by CBSE during the declaration of results. For this year, **students need to send the message to 7738299899**.

You can send a message in**the** **format (**cbse10   **) in 2026**. 

CBSE will directly send your results through an SMS.

### 5. Method 5: Check CBSE Result Through IVRS (Phone Call)

CBSE is also **known to offer Interactive Voice Response System (IVRS) which** **becomes** **active immediately after the result declaration**.

Students can **make a call to the official number, 24300699 (for Delhi** **subscribers****) and 011-****24300699** (for subscribers from other parts of India).

You have to **keep your details handy and enter them sequentially on your keypad as asked by the system**. In response, your [subjects’](https://www.21kschool.com/us/blog/difference-between-discipline-and-subject/#What_is_the_Subject) marks and overall results will be read out by the system.

You should remember that this call is not toll-free and charges 30 paise/minute.

### 6. Method 6: Check Result Through Your School

If you couldn’t get your results through any of the above mentioned means, you can directly contact your school. CBSE affiliated schools receive printed, official copies of class 10 results.

## Result of Class 10 CBSE 2026 – Important Dates & Highlights

Following some recent changes aligned [with the new education policy, CBSE Class 10 board examinations take place in two phases.](https://www.21kschool.com/us/blog/is-10th-board-removed-in-new-education-policy/)

**These are** **in the months of February to March** **and May to June**.

Exams are **being taken in 2026 for the first phase from 17th February to 11th March** and the **results will most probably be announced in** **mid May, 2026**.

However, the **2nd phase exams will be taken from May 15 to June 1, 2026, with final results predicted for late June 2026**.

**Students should constantly check the official announcements to confirm the dates and keep posted.**

## Understanding Your CBSE 10th Marksheet

While you are looking at your class 10 CBSE results, you should know all the details mentioned in it.

* **Student Name:** The student’s name should match with that in school records.

* **Father’s/Mother’s Name:** See if there is any mistake in the spelling of your father’s/mother’s name.

* Subject-wise Marks (Theory + Internal Assessment): This section includes theory and internal assessment marks, with scores awarded as per the [CBSE marking scheme.](https://www.21kschool.com/us/blog/cbse-marking-scheme/)

* **Subject-wise Grades (9-Point Grading Scale):** See if your marks and other criterias match the 9-points grades in the [CBSE grading system.](https://www.21kschool.com/us/blog/cbse-grading-system/)

* **Total Marks and Overall Grade:** Your total marks and aggregate [grade](https://www.21kschool.com/us/blog/grades-vs-percentage/#What_is_Grade) reveal your overall performance in CBSE class 10.

* **Result Status (Pass / Compartment / Essential Repeat / Fail):** Look at the final status of your results as Pass, Compartment, Essential Repeat, or Fail, and plan accordingly.

* **CGPA (Cumulative Grade Point Average):** [CGPA in CBSE](https://www.21kschool.com/us/blog/how-to-calculate-cgpa-in-cbse/#What_is_CGPA_in_CBSE) is a representation of the general performance.

* **Roll Number and School Code:** School code and roll number should be identical with your admit card.

Take all the **given details into account. If there is any discrepancy in the results, then** **contact** **your school.**

## How to Calculate CGPA from CBSE Class 10 Result

It is really easy to [calculate the CGPA from CBSE](https://www.21kschool.com/us/blog/how-to-calculate-cgpa-in-cbse/) Class 10 result:

### 1. CGPA Formula

The formula to calculate CGPA in CBSE is:

CGPA = Sum of Grade Points in all 5 main subjects ÷ 5

### 2. CGPA to Percentage Conversion

You can also **convert this CGPA into percentage and vice versa. The formula for calculating percentage would be:**

**Approximate Percentage = CGPA × 9.5**

However, starting from the 2024-25 academic session, CBSE has introduced a relative [grading system.](https://www.21kschool.com/us/blog/marking-vs-grading/#What_is_the_Grading_System)

### 3. Worked Example

For example, you can take marks from the table shown below:

|  |  |  |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Subject** | **Marks** | **Grade Points** |
| Hindi | 95 | 10 |
| English | 85 | 9 |
| Maths | 70 | 8 |
| Science | 98 | 10 |
| Social Science | 92 | 10 |

The **sum of all these grade points would be: Sum = 10+9+8+10+10 = 47**

**Now, you have to divide this sum by 5, which would be** **your** **CGPA = 47/5 = 9.4**

**Then, to calculate our approximate percentage we have to multiply** **this** **CGPA** **by** **9.5** **which** **would give us:**

**Approx. Percentage = 9.4 \* 9.5 = 89.3%**

## CBSE Class 10 Result: Pass Percentage Trends (2020–2025)

Annual pass **percentages in CBSE Class 10 have generally been over 90% in the years of 2020-2025. This time span is also called pandemic impacted years**.

The reports suggest that the performance has been progressing steadily because of internal [evaluation](https://www.21kschool.com/us/blog/difference-between-assessment-and-evaluation/#What_is_Evaluation) and question formats. The **recent trends follow the following data on pass percentage showing girls outperforming boys:**

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| **Year** | **Pass Percentage** |
| 2020 | 91.46% |
| 2021 | 99.04% (Highest in 5 years due to COVID assessment methods) |
| 2022 | 94.40% |
| 2023 | 93.12% |
| 2024 | 93.60% |
| 2025 | 93.66% |

## What to Do After Checking Your CBSE Class 10 Result

**After you have seen your results of class 10 CBSE, you have three options yo choose from. You can do the following:**

### 1. If You Passed – Next Steps

**[**Select the right stream in Class 11**](https://www.21kschool.com/us/blog/how-to-choose-the-right-stream-in-class-11/) depending on your performance and interest.**

For example, if you performed well in science and maths, you can choose Science stream. Mathematics may be **needed for commerce depending on** **career plans. Humanities have a variety of subjects.**

**Seek opinions of teachers and career counselors, and then make final decisions**.

### 2. If You Got Compartment – Don’t Panic

The **compartment result shows that you have to redo one or two subjects**.

**CBSE also takes compartment tests within a few months** of result declaration.

You should **focus on the [**application for CBSE compartment exams**](https://www.21kschool.com/us/blog/how-to-apply-for-compartment-exam-cbse/) and stick to your [**study routine**](https://www.21kschool.com/us/blog/study-routine/) covering the entire syllabus thoroughly this time and improve.**

### 3. If You Want to Improve Your Marks – Re-evaluation Process

In case you feel that you received lower grades than you think you deserve, you need to apply for [verification of cbse marks](https://www.21kschool.com/us/blog/what-is-verification-of-marks-in-cbse/) or re-evaluation before the deadline. CBSE offers a formal process for this as well.

## How to Download CBSE 10th Marksheet?

You **can access your CBSE class 10 provisional marksheet through the official sites or** **through** **DigiLocker. Your school shall then release the original marksheet**.

At all times make sure you **have digital and printed copies that you can use for admission or in** **documentation****.**

## Common Issues When Checking CBSE Class 10 Result

The **following common issues might appear while you try to check your result of class 10 CBSE:**

### 1. Website Not Loading / Server Error

On the **result day there can be heavy traffic, and thus websites might slow down. Wait and try later,** or get your results from DigiLocker.

### 2. Roll Number Not Found

**Verify credentials and pay close attention** **to what you type**. Make sure you do not have typing mistakes while entering your roll number.

If it shows **“roll number not found”, refer to your admit card once again and correctly enter it again.**

### 3. Result Shows “Not Available”

If the CBSE results website **shows “Not Available”, that could be because the results are yet to be uploaded.** So wait until there is an official declaration.

### 4. DigiLocker Account Not Activated

Make sure that **your mobile number is entered in your school records. CBSE provides instructions to follow during activation of DigiLocker account**.

## Myths vs Facts About CBSE Class 10 Results

**Some facts and myths about CBSE class 10 results can** **include****:**

### 1. **Myth: Your grades in Class 10 define your whole life.**

Fact: Although it is important, future performance is more important.

### 2. **Myth: Failure in a single subject would mean that the year has gone to waste.**

Fact: Compartment tests or the [CBSE improvement exam](https://www.21kschool.com/us/blog/what-is-the-cbse-improvement-exam/) enable the student to retake the test very soon.

### 3. **Myth: Online results cannot be considered valid.**

Fact: The provisional online results are accepted until the original certificate is provided.

## Conclusion

It is **really important for you to know how to check the result of class 10 CBSE if you are a recent exam** **taker**.

You can get your **results through multiple ways such as through official websites, DigiLocker, Umang App, SMS, or calls.**

You need to **have your necessary credentials with yourself whenever trying to access your class 10 CBSE results**.

In case you fail in a subject, prepare better and appear in the upcoming [compartment exams.](https://www.21kschool.com/us/blog/how-to-apply-for-compartment-exam-cbse/#What_is_a_Compartment_Exam)

## CBSE Board Results: Where and how to access CBSE results 2025

CBSE’s collaboration with the Ministry of Electronics and IT has strengthened its digital delivery system. In 2024, results were successfully delivered through DigiLocker and UMANG without major technical issues. With the “Result Available Soon” tag already visible on DigiLocker, the final declaration is expected any day now.Students should note that these provisional results are fully valid for university admissions, employment, and government procedures. Original marksheets can be collected from respective schools after the declaration.By following the official procedure, students can avoid last-minute delays and ensure a smooth result experience.

## Steps to check CBSE Result 2024 at cbseresults.nic.in

* ### Know How to Check CBSE Board Exam Results Online for 2024 at cbseresults.nic.in

To check your CBSE [board examination](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Board_examination) results online for 10th & 12th class for 2024 in just a few simple steps:

1. Visit the official website of CBSE at result.cbse.nic.in results.gov.in or cbse.gov.in.

According to CBSE criteria, no overall division or distinction is awarded. If a student has over five subjects, the best five may be considered by the admitting institution or employer. The board does not calculate or declare percentages. Institutions or employers may calculate if needed for higher education or employment purposes.

The National Informatics Centre (NIC) plays a technical and infrastructure role in declaring exam results, like those of the Central Board of Secondary Education. While, CBSE creates and owns the results, NIC enables their safe and smooth online delivery to students across the country.

Here’s what NIC does:

1. Hosts result websites

NIC manages and maintains official result portals such as results.nic.in and cbseresults.nic.in. These websites are built on NIC’s secure government servers.

2. Handles heavy traffic

On result day, millions of students try to check their scores at the same time. NIC provides the backend infrastructure (servers, load balancing, cloud support) to prevent crashes and ensure smooth access.

3. Ensures data security

NIC safeguards sensitive student data, ensuring results are published securely without leaks or tampering.

4. Supports result publishing systems

CBSE prepares the result data, but NIC helps deploy it online—integrating databases with web interfaces so students can check scores using roll numbers and other credentials.

5. Coordinates with platforms like DigiLocker

NIC also works with digital platforms to enable marksheets to be accessed electronically.

CBSE has announced a special assessment scheme for Class 10 students in the Middle East after cancelling the remaining board exams. Instead of conducting a new examination, the board will declare results based on a formula-based evaluation. Marks will be calculated from the papers a student has already appeared for, with averages of best-performing subjects used wherever exams were missed.

As per the Board’s latest notice, CBSE has created a category-wise marking formula based on the number of exams attempted:

–Appeared in all exams: Marks will be awarded based on actual performance in all subjects.

–Appeared in 4 exams: Average of the best three subjects will be used.

–Appeared in 3 exams: Average of the best two subjects will be considered.

–Appeared in 2 exams: Result will be based on the average marks of those two papers.

Students who appeared in only one or two subjects — especially those from previous batches (last year or earlier) who registered for limited papers — will have their results prepared based on available performance. If they missed any exam, they will be allowed to appear in the second board examination cycle, which the CBSE has newly introduced for this session of exams.

# CBSE Class 10th Result 2025 Declared: How to Check, Calculate Percentage & What to Do Next

* ACIO
* May 14, 2025

![](https://d23hiuzhfk4xdw.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/14125844/780x470-10.jpg)

The Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) has officially announced the Class 10th Result 2025 on, May 13, 2025. This long-awaited result is now available for over 24 lakh students who appeared for the examination across India and abroad. Students can access their results online through the official CBSE websites—cbseresults.nic.in, cbse.gov.in, and results.cbse.nic.in.

This moment marks a significant milestone in the academic journey of every Class 10 student, opening the doors to stream selection, career planning, and future goals. Whether you’re a student in India or enrolled in a CBSE-affiliated school overseas (especially in the GCC region), this result sets the foundation for your next big step: choosing the right stream in Class 11.

At Allen Overseas, we congratulate all students for their efforts and results and are here to guide you on what to do next.

#### **Overview: CBSE Class 10th Board Exam 2025**

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| **Key Detail** | **Information** |
| Exam Conducting Body | Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) |
| Class | 10th |
| Total Students Appeared | Approx. 24 lakh |
| Result Declaration Date | May 13, 2025 |
| Pass Percentage | 93.66% |
| Official Websites | [cbseresults.nic.in, cbse.gov.in](https://cbse.gov.in/) |
| Available Platforms | CBSE website, DigiLocker, SMS, UMANG App |

#### **How to Check CBSE Class 10 Result 2025 Online (Step-by-Step Guide)**

Students who appeared for the CBSE board exams can check and download their marksheet online by following these easy steps:

##### 1. On CBSE Official Website:

Step 1: Visit the official CBSE websites—[cbseresults.nic.in](https://cbseresults.nic.in/) or [cbse.gov.in](https://cbse.gov.in/)  
 Step 2: On the homepage, click on the link for “CBSE 10th Result 2025”  
 Step 3: Enter your roll number, school number, centre number, and admit card ID  
 Step 4: Your CBSE Result 2025 will be shown on the screen  
 Step 5: Download the marksheet and save it  
 Step 6: Take a printout or screenshot for future use

##### 2. On DigiLocker App/Website:

Go to <https://www.digilocker.gov.in>

Sign in with your Aadhaar-linked mobile number

Access your marksheet under “Issued Documents” from CBSE

##### 3. Via SMS:

Type: CBSE10

Send it to the number provided by CBSE

You’ll receive your result via text message

#### How to Calculate Your CBSE Class 10 2025 Percentage?

Once you get your marksheet, calculating your overall percentage is simple. CBSE gives marks out of 100 for each subject, and typically 5 subjects are considered for percentage calculation.

##### Step-by-Step Method:

* Add the marks of your top 5 main subjects (typically English, Hindi, Maths, Science, Social Science)
* Divide the total by 5
* The result is your percentage

Example:

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| Subject | Marks |
| English | 95 |
| Hindi | 88 |
| Maths | 91 |
| Science | 89 |
| Social Science | 93 |

Total = 95 + 88 + 91 + 89 + 93 = 456  
 Percentage = 456 ÷ 5 = 91.2%

🔁 If you’ve taken a 6th subject, CBSE considers the best 5 subjects automatically for calculating your result status (pass/fail). But for calculating your own percentage, use the top 5 scoring subjects.

##### What to Do After CBSE 10th Result 2025? Career Options & Next Steps

Your CBSE Class 10th result is out – whether you’ve scored exceptionally well or feel there’s room for improvement, this is a crucial turning point in your academic journey. Here’s a step-by-step guide on what students should do next:

##### 1. Understand Your Result and Reflect

* Check your **marksheet carefully** — verify subject-wise marks, spelling of your name, and personal details.
* Reflect on your **performance** — identify your strengths and areas that need improvement.
* Don’t compare your result with others. Focus on your own growth and goals.

##### 2. Explore Stream Options in Class 11

Based on your interest and aptitude, you can choose one of the three main streams:

* Science – Ideal for those interested in Engineering, Medicine, Research, etc.
* Commerce – For careers in Business, Finance, Management, CA/CS, etc.
* Humanities (Arts) – Great for Law, Psychology, Design, Journalism, Civil Services, etc.

Talk to your teachers, parents, or academic counsellors to make an informed decision.

##### 3. Seek Career Guidance (if unsure)

If you’re confused about which stream to choose, consider:

* Taking aptitude or psychometric tests
* Attending career counselling sessions (Allen Overseas offers this!)
* Exploring future careers and matching them with your interests and skills

##### 4. Enroll in a Foundation or Bridge Course

If you’re aiming for:

* Engineering or Medical (JEE/NEET)
* Olympiads/NTSE/KVPY
* Board exam excellence in Class 11–12

##### 5. Set Academic and Personal Goals

* Decide what you want to achieve in Class 11 (board score target, competition preparation, etc.)
* Build a study schedule that includes academics, hobbies, and personal time
* Improve skills like time management, communication, and digital literacy

## **Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) – CBSE Class 10 Result 2025**

**1. Where can I check my CBSE Class 10 result 2025?**  
 Answer : You can check your result on the official CBSE website:  
 [cbseresults.nic.in,](https://cbseresults.nic.in/)[cbse.gov.in,](https://cbse.gov.in/)[results.cbse.nic.in](https://results.cbse.nic.in/)

You can also use the DigiLocker App, UMANG App, or SMS service.

**2. What credentials are required to check the result online?**

Answer : You need the following:

* Roll Number
* School Number
* Date of Birth (as per CBSE admit card)

**3. I forgot my roll number. How can I retrieve it?**

Answer : You can find it on your CBSE admit card. If lost, contact your school immediately—they can access it through the CBSE portal.

**4. How is the percentage calculated in CBSE Class 10?**

Answer : Your percentage is calculated using marks of the best 5 subjects:  
 Add marks of top 5 scoring subjects

Divide by 5

Example: If your total marks in best 5 subjects = 450, then

Percentage = 450 ÷ 5 = 90%

**5. What if I’m not satisfied with my marks?**

Answer: You can:

* Apply for re-evaluation or verification of marks on the CBSE website
* Appear in the Improvement Exam (if eligible)
* CBSE usually announces the re-evaluation schedule within a week after the result declaration.

**6. Is there a way to download a digital copy of the marksheet?**

Answer : Yes. Visit [www.digilocker.gov.in](https://www.digilocker.gov.in/) or use the DigiLocker app. Sign in using your Aadhaar-linked mobile number to access your digital marksheet and migration certificate issued by CBSE.

**7. What is the passing criteria for CBSE Class 10?**

Answer : To pass, a student must:

Score 33% marks in each subject (theory + internal assessment combined)

Pass in at least 5 subjects

**8. What happens if I fail in one or two subjects?**

Answer : CBSE conducts Compartment Exams (supplementary exams). You can reappear in the subject(s) you failed. Check the CBSE website for dates and instructions.

**9. Can I change my stream after Class 10?**

Answer : Yes. After Class 10, you can choose between

* Science
* Commerce
* Humanities

Your school will usually allow you to choose based on your performance and aptitude. Consider taking expert counselling for the right decision.

**10. Are Allen Overseas programs available for Class 11 after CBSE 10th?**

Answer : Absolutely! Allen Overseas offers structured coaching for:

* Class 11 CBSE
* JEE/NEET preparation
* Olympiads & NTSE
* Foundation & career guidance

# CBSE 10th Result out 2026- Date, Time and How to Check Online

Over 23 lakh students are waiting on the same thing right now. The [CBSE 10th result 2026](https://ctuniversity.in/programme-courses-type/After%20Matric) is expected between late April and May, and when it drops, results.cbse.nic.in will be the first place it appears. If you appeared for Class 10 board exams this year, this blog covers the expected date, exactly how to check your score, what your marksheet will show and — more importantly — what to do in the days immediately after results are out.

Table of Contents

1. [CBSE 10th Result 2026 Expected Date and Time](#expected-date)
2. [How to Check CBSE 10th Result 2026 by Roll Number](#how-to-check)
3. [How to Check CBSE 10th Result 2026 on DigiLocker](#digilocker)
4. [What Your CBSE 10th Result 2026 Marksheet Will Show](#marksheet)
5. [Passing Marks and Compartment Rules](#passing-marks)
6. [What to Do After CBSE 10th Result 2026](#what-next)
7. [Frequently Asked Questions](#faq)

## CBSE 10th Result 2026 Date and Time

CBSE has announced the Class 10 result on 15th April.

The official result will be live on results.cbse.nic.in and cbse.gov.in. CBSE also typically sends an SMS to registered mobile numbers when results go live. Students can type CBSE10 followed by their roll number and send it to 7738299899 on result day.

## How to Check CBSE 10th Result 2026 by Roll Number

The process is quick. Keep your admit card handy before you start.

1. Open results [**cbse.nic.in**](https://www.cbse.gov.in/) on your phone or computer
2. Click on the Class 10 result link on the homepage
3. Enter your roll number, school number, admit card ID and date of birth
4. Click Submit
5. Your CBSE 10th result 2026 will appear with subject-wise marks
6. Download the result or take a screenshot immediately

The site slows down badly in the first hour after declaration — every year without fail. If it does not load, wait ten minutes and try again. DigiLocker is a faster alternative and works even when the main site is under heavy traffic.

### How to Check CBSE 10th Result 2026 on DigiLocker

1. Open [**digilocker.gov.in**](https://www.digilocker.gov.in/) in or the DigiLocker app
2. Log in with your Aadhaar-linked mobile number
3. Search for CBSE Class 10 marksheet under Education documents
4. Your result will appear once CBSE pushes it to the system

The DigiLocker marksheet is official and accepted by colleges for provisional admission. It carries the same legal validity as a physical copy.

## What Your CBSE 10th Result 2026 Marksheet Will Show

Your result page and eventual physical marksheet carry:

* • Full name and roll number
* • Subject-wise marks — theory and internal assessment separately
* • Total marks obtained out of total
* • Pass, Fail or Compartment status
* • School number and date of birth

The result on results.cbse.nic.in is provisional. Your school distributes the original marksheet after CBSE completes its dispatch process. Keep the downloaded copy safe — most institutions accept it for admissions until the original arrives.

## CBSE 10th Result 2026 — Passing Marks and Compartment Rules

To pass Class 10 boards, students need a minimum of 33% in each subject, counting both theory and internal assessment together. Students who fall short in one subject may be declared compartment rather than fail outright. The compartment exam is held separately, usually in July, and clearing it means the student is fully passed for that year.

If you are in compartment, check cbse.gov.in for the compartment exam schedule once results are declared. The window to apply is short.

## What to Do After CBSE 10th Result 2026

Most students spend the first week after results either celebrating or recovering. That is fine. But the second week is where the real decisions happen — and those decisions tend to get rushed because nobody planned ahead.

The two questions that matter right after Class 10 results are which direction you want to go and which institution gives you the best shot at getting there. Diploma programs are the route most students overlook. They take three years, build hands-on skills faster than a straight degree path and open doors to both employment and lateral entry into degree programs later.

CT University, Ludhiana offers diploma programs for students who clear their Class 10 boards. Diploma in Civil Engineering and Diploma in Computer Science and Engineering are both open to students with 50% or more in Maths, Science and English at the 10th level. Both are three-year programs with industry-focused training built into the curriculum. For students in Punjab who want to stay close to home without giving up quality, CT University is worth a serious look before admission rounds close.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Q1. When will CBSE 10th result 2026 be declared?

The result is expected between late April and mid-May 2026. CBSE has not confirmed the exact date yet. Keep checking results.cbse.nic.in for official updates.

### Q2. How do I check CBSE 10th result 2026 by roll number?

Go to results.cbse.nic.in, click the Class 10 result link, enter your roll number, school number, admit card ID and date of birth, then submit. Your result appears on screen.

### Q3. Is the DigiLocker CBSE result valid for college admission?

Yes. The DigiLocker marksheet is an official government-issued document and is accepted by most colleges and universities for provisional admission.

### Q4. What is compartment in CBSE 10th result?

If you fail in one subject but clear all others, CBSE may declare you compartment instead of fail. You can appear in the compartment exam held in July to clear the pending subject.

### Q5. What is the passing percentage for CBSE Class 10 2026?

Students need 33% in each subject — theory and internal assessment combined — to pass. Subject-specific minimums apply for theory and practicals as per CBSE's marking scheme.

### Q6. What should I do if results.cbse.nic.in is not loading?

Heavy traffic slows the site on result day. Switch to DigiLocker or the UMANG app — both carry official CBSE results and usually load faster than the main portal.

Your CBSE 10th result is one number on one day. What you do with the next two weeks decides a lot more. College seats fill fast after results and students who had already shortlisted their options before result day consistently end up with more choices than those who started thinking afterward.

Check your result at results.cbse.nic.in on declaration day. If you are in Punjab and looking at diploma or degree programs, start comparing your options the same week — not the week after.

## CBSE 10th Phase 2 Result 2026

CBSE 10th Second Board exam result 2026 has been announced. This is considered an improvement exam. All passed and eligible students were allowed to improve their performance in any of the three subjects out of Science, Mathematics, Social, Science and languages in the Phase 2 exam. If a student who did not appear in 3 or more subjects in the first examination was not allowed to appear in the second exam. Such students were placed in the "Essential Repeat" category and can take the examination only next year in the main examinations in February. For students whose result in the first examination was Compartment, such students were allowed to appear in second examination under the Compartment Category.  The eligibility to appear in the second examination is given below.

## CBSE 10th Result Re-Evaluation & Verification 2026

Students can now apply to obtain photocopies of their answer sheet by paying a fee without having to necessarily apply for verification or revaluation. Students will be required to pay INR 500 per subject for verification of marks as well as for obtaining photocopies of evaluated mark sheets. The application process for the re-evaluation of the answer sheets starts in June. The re-evaluation fee per subject is INR 100. CBSE 10th Rechecking/Revaluation Result is announced in June.

Students who are not satisfied with their marks can apply for rechecking or revaluation of the papers by paying a fee. The process involves rechecking the marks by a different examiner while verification checks for any clerical error. They can also apply for verification of marks. Students are required to fill out the verification application form online on the official website. Once the application form is submitted, the board re-checks the answer sheets for totalling errors, missing out marks while totalling, or unchecked/ unmarked questions. After re-checking, the board will share the result with the students and allow them to request a photocopy of their re-checked CBSE Class 10th result.

# CBSE Class 10 Result 2026: Expected Date, Official Websites, and How to Download Scorecard PDF

The **CBSE Class 10 Result 2026** is expected to be announced by **late April 2026**, earlier than the traditional May schedule. Students can access their marksheets on **cbse.gov.in** and **results.cbse.nic.in** using their roll number and date of birth.

![authorImage](https://static.pw.live/5eb393ee95fab7468a79d189/efadd7a9-a7c3-4ad2-a861-399c5ec48922.jpeg)[Varnika Srivastava](/authors/varnika-srivastava)4 Apr, 2026

![CBSE Class 10 Result 2026: Expected Date, Official Websites, and How to Download Scorecard PDF](https://static.pw.live/5eb393ee95fab7468a79d189/GLOBAL_CMS/251b9ac7-615c-4713-b2cc-2c0c883a1c8d.webp)![CBSE Class 10 Result 2026: Expected Date, Official Websites, and How to Download Scorecard PDF](https://static.pw.live/5eb393ee95fab7468a79d189/GLOBAL_CMS/021916d8-237d-4616-af90-df5515ccc165.webp)

Millions of students across India are awaiting the **CBSE Class 10 Exam Result 2026**. According to latest reports and internal board sources, the Central Board of Secondary Education is expected to fast-track the announcement, with a likely release date in the **final week of April 2026**.

While the 2025 results were declared on May 13, the earlier conclusion of exams this year suggests a pro-active release schedule to facilitate early admissions for the new academic session.

## Official Portals to Check CBSE 10th Result 2026

When the result is declared, students can verify their marks on these official platforms:

* [**cbse.gov.in**](https://www.cbse.gov.in/)
* [**results.cbse.nic.in**](https://results.cbse.nic.in/)
* [**cbseresults.nic.in**](https://results.cbse.nic.in/)
* **DigiLocker** (App and Portal)

### Step-by-Step: How to Download CBSE Class 10 Scorecard 2026 PDF

Follow these verified steps to get your digital marksheet:

1. Visit the official CBSE result website ([results.cbse.nic.in](https://results.cbse.nic.in/)).
2. Locate and click on the link for **"Secondary School Examination (Class X) Results 2026"**.
3. Enter your **Registration Number**, **Roll Number**, and **Date of Birth**.
4. The **CBSE 10th Scorecard PDF** will be displayed on your screen.
5. Click 'Download' and take a hard copy for future reference.

## CBSE 10th Result Date Trends: A 10-Year Analysis

Historically, CBSE releases the Class 10 results in May, but the timeline has fluctuated significantly over the last decade:

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| **Year** | **Result Declaration Date** |
| **2025** | May 13 |
| **2024** | May 13 |
| **2023** | May 12 |
| **2022** | July 22 |
| **2021** | August 3 |
| **2020** | July 15 |
| **2019** | May 6 |
| **2018** | May 29 |
| **2017** | June 3 |
| **2016** | May 28 |

## CBSE Class 12 Result 2026 Update

Following the usual trend where the Class 12 results are announced either on the same day or shortly after Class 10, students can expect the **CBSE 12th Result 2026** by **May 20, 2026**. This timeframe aligns with the 40-day window following the final exam held on April 9.

To download the **CBSE 12th scorecard 2026**, students will require their admit card details, specifically the roll number and school code.

**Q1: What is the exact date for CBSE Class 10 Result 2026?**

As per current trends, the result is highly likely to be out by **April-end 2026**. CBSE usually provides a 24-hour advance notice on their official social media handles.

**Q2: Which credentials are needed to check the CBSE 10th result?**

You will need your **Roll Number**, **Date of Birth**, and **School Number** as mentioned on your 2026 Admit Card.

**Q3: Can I check my CBSE result via SMS?**

Yes, CBSE typically provides an SMS organizer service. You can send `CBSE10`  to the designated board number (usually 7738299899) once the results are live.

**Q4: Will the board release a Toppers List for 2026?**

To prevent unhealthy competition, CBSE has recently avoided publishing an official "Toppers List," though they do issue merit certificates to the top 0.1% of students.

**Q5: What if the official website crashes?**

Due to high traffic, the official site may slow down. In such cases, students are advised to use the **DigiLocker App** or the **UMANG App**, which are pre-synced with the CBSE database.
